content: R1b TOTAL PURITY (user directive): every supervision package now = apk owner of its Exec binary. Renames: oo7-user-dinit -> oo7-server-user-dinit (owner of oo7-daemon), playerctld-user-dinit -> playerctl-user-dinit (owner of playerctld). Splits: gnome-apps-user-dinit -> 4 owner packages; plasma-kauth-dinit -> 11 owner system packages (powerdevil x4, plasma-workspace fontinst+localegenhelper, kdeplasma-addons kameleon, plasma-desktop kcmclock=cmdatetimehelper, sddm-kcm, plasma-disks smart, kinfocenter dmidecode, libksysguard processlist=NOT ksystemstats, ktexteditor, discover alpineapkbackend, plasma-firewall ufw). provides= kept ONLY for owner-underivable Execs (oo7 traps 2 bus aliases, obexd bare command, signon-ui /bin/sh). aports 9f39006+9eb7a65 (abuild 3.17 checksums POSITIONAL vs source= order — CI catch), CI 42373560596 green. Matrix re-proven ALL GREEN: niri 2026-11-07T13-01-53Z 115/115, kde 13-16-18Z 78/78 (15 kauth via owner pkgs), niriWayle 13-26-28Z 118/118 (oo7_pam_unlock live), cosmic 13-44-20Z 78/78 (playerctld direct who-owns). Owners verified per-binary on pkgs.alpinelinux.org (edge empty for plasma-desktop helpers -> v3.24 fallback).

R1b naming map for KDE KAuth helpers (verified on Alpine): backlighthelper/chargethreshold/discretegpu/wakeupsource=powerdevil, fontinst+localegenhelper=plasma-workspace, kameleon=kdeplasma-addons, kcmclock(kcmdatetimehelper)=plasma-desktop, kcmsddm=sddm-kcm, kded.smart=plasma-disks, dmidecode=kinfocenter, processlisthelper=libksysguard (NOT ksystemstats), katetextbuffer=ktexteditor, alpineapkbackend=discover, ufw=plasma-firewall. Gotchas: pkgs.alpinelinux.org edge index EMPTY for some helpers (use v3.24 fallback); abuild 3.17 sha512sums verification is POSITIONAL (must follow source= order); GNOME app Exec paths: gnome-disks binary=gnome-disk-utility pkg, /usr/share/gnome-maps/org.gnome.Maps=gnome-maps pkg.

Full review round (2 audit agents -> 3 stages): P1 fixes (ce420cc): install_config heredoc -> WriteFile 0600 (heredoc LOGGED the user/LUKS password — secret leak), SetupDbusAudit+services.go deterministic test probes -> allowFail+echo-OK sentinel (ignoreErrors made skip dead code; interactive got retry prompt), chroot_env repositories WriteFile, SetCaller reset after audit. Rules-ification (0c1a3de, 19 files): 12 new internal_rules keys (standardUserGroups, dinitSkipSessionManaged 13 names, feralosRepo.keyringUrl, kernel pkg+flavor, microcode amd/intel, edgeRepositories, resolvNameservers, maintenanceCron x4, limits nofile x2, nix channel+registryRef, DE userServices + greeterGroups); LoadInternalRules validates always-consumed; byte-identical diff-proof 17 outputs; dinitShutdownCommands STAYS in services.go (user decision). Misplacements: login-shell trick -> niri.go/niri_wayle.go step 4b (users.go DE-agnostic), turnstiled via services map, ursine dir -> misc, AppendUnique -> utils/logic, podman packages owned by feature, fwupd null key -> comment, dead WebminPackages removed, niri lists firewalld explicitly. REGRESSION CAUGHT (run 15-56-12Z 112/115): ensureIncusAdminGroup deletion WRONG — packageLogic.incus.groups fires at ApplyRules (config-load) time but incus enters the list LATER (features/extraPackages) -> incus-admin never created -> adduser failed x3; restored verbatim (86f9143); re-run 16-26-43Z 115/115. LESSON: packageLogic groups/services only cover packages present at ApplyRules time — late-arriving packages need install-time fallbacks. Guards: TestRulesCarryRequiredTunables + TestDiskLayoutsPinned. Open: firstBoot/tpm/main.go booster-lts literals (standalone binary); webmin_http transient 2x (PASS on retry).

packageLogic timing rule: ApplyRules runs at CONFIG-LOAD time — groups/services/modules from packageLogic only cover packages ALREADY in the list then. Packages arriving later (features.XxxPackages, extraPackages, flatpakPackages) need install-time fallbacks (e.g. ensureIncusAdminGroup apk-info probe). Deleting such fallbacks because 'rules cover it' is wrong — the harness regression (incus-admin unknown group, run 2026-11-07T15-56-12Z) proved it. Related: deterministic probes (test -x, getent) must use allowFail+sentinel, never the retry machinery — ignoreErrors makes the error nil (skip branch dead) and interactive installs get prompted.
